name: sweep-next-edit-vscode
description: Next-edit prediction inline suggestions powered by Sweep Next-Edit 1.5B (local GGUF via llama.cpp).

sweepNextEdit.enabled.description: Enable Sweep Next Edit inline suggestions.

sweepNextEdit.modelPath.description: Path to the Sweep Next-Edit GGUF model file (e.g. sweep-next-edit-1.5b.q8_0.v2.gguf). If empty, the extension will look for the file in the first workspace folder.

sweepNextEdit.contextLines.description: Number of lines above/below the cursor to include (Sweep format uses 10).

sweepNextEdit.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate for the updated window.

sweepNextEdit.logging.description: Write debug logs to the 'Sweep Next Edit' output channel.

sweepNextEdit.triggerDebounceMs.description: Debounce (ms) after typing before triggering inline suggestions.

sweepNextEdit.contextFileCount.description: Number of other open workspace files to include as context.

sweepNextEdit.contextFileMaxChars.description: Max characters to include per context file.
